# `deposits.term_deposit.WithholdingApplied`

Withholding tax applied flow-by-flow to the gross interest, with Net = Gross - Tax conserved to the cent. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); no PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tax_cents` | `long` | Withholding Tax as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents). |
| `net_cents` | `long` | Net interest as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents). |

## Governing ADRs

[ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md)
